opportunities.title: Synthesis grants

amount.raw: up to £30,000 over two years for groups of 8-15 participants

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Main applicant must have BES membership; groups of 8-15 individuals with diverse mix of career stages, institutions and international participation.
opportunities.summary: Bring together diverse interdisciplinary groups of 8-15 individuals to focus on data analysis and synthesis, fostering collaboration and mentoring, with outputs to inform decision-making by stakeholders.

opportunities.title: Long-term research grants

amount.raw: £3,500 for the first five years plus an additional £3,500 in the sixth year (up to £500/year for a decade of data collection)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership; open to all types of ecologists including conservation practitioners; awarded to individuals, not organisations.
opportunities.summary: Provides a small amount of funding each year for 10 years to enable existing short-term projects (with 1-2 years of data) to be funded into the long term, supporting long-term ecological studies anywhere in the world.

opportunities.title: Pedagogical research and development grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership; open to anyone involved in teaching ecology at any level; awarded to individuals, not organisations.
opportunities.summary: Funds research on education methods within ecology to develop evidence informing teaching and learning practices that improve the student experience, projects up to 12 months.

opportunities.title: Connecting ecologists with other disciplines grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership; open to PhD students, postdoctoral fellows, early career ecologists, established researchers or employees of other organisations; undergraduates and masters students not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Funds placements/secondments (up to 12 months) that immerse an ecologist in a distinctly different discipline or sector (another discipline, NGO, charity, public sector, business), promoting interdisciplinary skills.

opportunities.title: Small research grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership; funding for researchers from all countries globally; projects can be conducted anywhere in the world.
opportunities.summary: Supports new and innovative ecological research of the highest international standard, with a clear ecological science focus.

opportunities.title: Outreach and engagement grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Lead applicant must have BES membership; open to individuals, teams and organisations across all experience levels; projects up to 12 months.
opportunities.summary: Supports BES members to deliver independent outreach, public engagement and science communication activities that engage public audiences with the excitement, importance and relevance of ecological science.

opportunities.title: Training and travel grants

amount.raw: maximum £500 for in-person events, £250 for virtual conferences/courses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must be a BES member; PhD student or postgraduate researcher registered on a postgraduate research degree programme; work/study at a university or research institution.
opportunities.summary: Helps PhD students and postgraduate researchers meet the costs of specialist field training courses and present their work at workshops and conferences; awarded on a lottery-based system.

opportunities.title: Annual Meeting Grants 2026
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must be a BES member; citizen of and based in a Global South country; must have applied to present at the Annual Meeting; at least three years since last BES Training and Travel Grant.
opportunities.summary: Supports researchers based in Global South countries to attend the BES Annual Meeting in the UK, covering costs such as registration, transport, food and accommodation; selected by lottery.
